title: The Island Pier
text: Birnbeck Pier opened in 1867 and remains unique as Britain's only pier linking the mainland directly to an island. Paddle steamers connected Weston-super-Mare with ports around the Bristol Channel while the island hosted amusements, pavilions and seaside attractions.

title: HMS Birnbeck
text: During the Second World War Birnbeck Pier became HMS Birnbeck, a secret Admiralty research station. Experimental naval weapons, including work connected with Barnes Wallis projects, were tested in the Bristol Channel.
check: Wikipedia: an outpost of the Admiralty's Directorate of Miscellaneous Weapons Development from 1941; it says the bouncing bomb was tested at Brean Down Fort, not on the pier.
